label: Radial–angular description of a point
subgoals: Fix the pole O, the polar axis, and CCW orientation
Project rho at angle theta into x = rho*cos(theta), y = rho*sin(theta)
Split Q into radial rho = |OQ| plus angle theta

label: Determining the angle \\(\theta\\)
subgoals: Divide y/x into tan(theta) and flag the theta+pi ambiguity
Pin the quadrant with cos(theta) = x/rho and sin(theta) = y/rho
Collapse the origin to (0, theta) for any theta

label: Non-uniqueness of polar representation
subgoals: Add 2*pi*k to theta without moving the point
Flip (rho,theta) into (-rho,theta+pi) for the same point
Restrict to rho >= 0, theta in [0,2*pi) for uniqueness
